claims.text: Mandate Article 22: English, Arabic and Hebrew official languages.
Ben-Yehuda: first Modern Hebrew-speaking household, Jerusalem 1881; dictionary from 1910; British recognition of Hebrew in 1922.
HeHalutz: founded 1905; 25 countries 1930–35; ~100,000 members by 1939, ~60,000 already emigrated, 16,000 in training.
Elected Assembly and National Council set up 1920; Mapai formed 1930.
Hashomer founded 1909, never more than 100 members, disbanded on the Haganah's founding in 1920.
Degania founded on JNF land; 82 kibbutzim and 26,550 people by 1940.
